meaning:
κάμπτω
[in LXX chiefly for כָּרַע, 4Ki.1:13, 2Ch.29:29, Isa.45:24 (23), al. ;]
to bend, bow: with accusative of thing(s), γόνυ, τὰ γ.; with dative of person(s), τῇ Βάαλ, Rom.11:4 (LXX); πρὸς τ. πατέρα, Eph.3:14; by meton., πᾶν γόνυ for πᾶς, Rom.14:11 (LXX) Php.2:10 (cf. ἀνα-, συν-κάμπτω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
